newsitem.title: USA: HLD Emery opens Venezuela office.
newsitem.headline: HLD Emery opens Venezuela office.

text.p: Emery Worldwide announced Wednesday that it has opened an office in Valencia, Venezuela, its first in that country.

"With the loosening of trade barriers in the Latin American region, we are seeing an upsurge of North-South traffic on the part of automotive companies," said Ron Young, vice president, Latin America, in a statement.
Emery also established a new operating company in Buenos Aires, Argentina, in May.

The new Valencia office, which offers complete services including a bonded warehouse, is a joint arrangment between Emery and its local agent in Caracas, Aerofletes S.A., with whom the company has worked for more than 20 years, the company said.
According to Young, Valencia is serviced directly from Miami where Emery maintains its major gateway serving Latin America.
Emery, which operates as freight forwarder in Latin America, is the Redwood City, Ca.-based subsidiary of Consolidated Freightways Inc. of Palo Alto, Calif.
